title: UP Scholarship Class 9 to 12 Online Form 2020
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://scholarship.up.gov.in
2. Select Pre-Matric (Class 9–12)
3. Fresh / Renewal application
4. Fill school and bank details
5. Submit for school verification
shortDescription: UP Scholarship Class 9 to 12 Online Form – Pre-Matric applications on scholarship.up.gov.in.
content:
Pre-Matric Scholarship for Class 9 to 12 students in Uttar Pradesh is applied online through the state scholarship portal.

For current academic year last dates, check scholarship.up.gov.in.
